function backgroundSizeCase(v) {
  document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';document.documentElement.style.fontSize='20px';
  const parent=document.createElement('main');parent.style.fontSize='20px';document.body.append(parent);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.append(sheet);
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.id='target';parent.append(e);const s=getComputedStyle(e),checks={};
  const check=(name,css,expected,rules='')=>{sheet.textContent=rules;e.style.cssText='width:40px;height:10px;'+css;checks[name]=s.backgroundSize===expected&&s.getPropertyValue('background-size')===expected&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width===40&&e.getBoundingClientRect().height===10;};
  check('default','','auto');check('auto','background-size:auto','auto');check('autoPair','background-size:auto auto','auto');check('cover','background-size:cover','cover');check('contain','background-size:contain','contain');
  check('singleLength',`background-size:${v+3}px`,`${v+3}px auto`);check('heightOnly','background-size:auto 20px','auto 20px');check('lengthPair',`background-size:${v+3}px ${v+4}px`,`${v+3}px ${v+4}px`);check('percentage','background-size:20% 30%','20% 30%');
  check('zero','background-size:0 0','0px 0px');check('absolute','background-size:1in 2in','96px 192px');check('em','background-size:1em 2em','20px 40px');check('rem','font-size:40px;background-size:1rem 2rem','20px 40px');check('viewport','background-size:1vw 1vh',`${innerWidth/100}px ${innerHeight/100}px`);
  check('lengthMath','background-size:calc(1em + 2px) calc(2em - 3px)','22px 37px');check('mixedMath','background-size:calc(20% + 2em) calc(50% - 3px)','calc(20% + 40px) calc(50% - 3px)');check('product','background-size:calc((20% + 1em)*2)','calc(40% + 40px) auto');
  check('negativeLengthMath','background-size:calc(1px - 2px)','0px auto');check('negativePercentageMath','background-size:calc(10% - 20%)','0% auto');check('mixedNegativeMath','background-size:calc(-10% - 2px)','calc(-10% - 2px) auto');check('zeroPercentageMath','background-size:calc(0% - 2px)','calc(0% - 2px) auto');
  check('minimum','background-size:min(1em,30px) min(20%,2em)','20px min(20%, 40px)');check('maximum','background-size:max(1em,30px) max(20%,2em)','30px max(20%, 40px)');check('clamp','background-size:clamp(30px,1em,10px) clamp(10%,2em,60%)','30px clamp(10%, 40px, 60%)');check('percentageFunctions','background-size:min(20%,50%) clamp(10%,20%,50%)','20% 20%');check('nested','background-size:min(20%,max(10%,2em))','min(20%, max(10%, 40px)) auto');
  check('layeredMath','background-image:none,none,none;background-size:min(20%,2em)','min(20%, 40px) auto, min(20%, 40px) auto, min(20%, 40px) auto');
  check('layers','background-image:none,none,none;background-size:20px,cover','20px auto, cover, 20px auto');check('trimLayers','background-size:20px,cover','20px auto');check('defaultLayers','background-image:none,none,none','auto, auto, auto');
  check('variable',`--size:${v+3}px 20%;background-size:var(--size)`,`${v+3}px 20%`);check('fallback','background-size:var(--missing,cover)','cover');check('invalidVariable','background-size:var(--missing)','auto');check('invalidVariableValue','--size:red;background-size:var(--size)','auto');
  check('specificity','','cover','div{background-size:contain}#target{background-size:cover}');check('sourceOrder','','cover','#target{background-size:contain}#target{background-size:cover}');check('inlineOrigin','background-size:20px','20px auto','#target{background-size:cover}');check('important','background-size:20px','cover','#target{background-size:cover!important}');
  check('cascadeLayers','','cover','@layer early,late;@layer early{#target{background-size:contain}}@layer late{div{background-size:cover}}');check('importantLayers','','contain','@layer early,late;@layer early{div{background-size:contain!important}}@layer late{#target{background-size:cover!important}}');
  sheet.textContent='';parent.style.cssText='font-size:20px;background-size:1em 2em,cover';check('notInherited','','auto');check('inheritTrimmed','font-size:40px;background-image:none,none,none;background-size:inherit','20px 40px, 20px 40px, 20px 40px');parent.style.backgroundImage='none,none,none';check('inheritExpanded','font-size:40px;background-image:none,none,none,none,none;background-size:inherit','20px 40px, cover, 20px 40px, 20px 40px, cover');parent.style.backgroundImage='none';checks.liveParentLayers=s.backgroundSize==='20px 40px, 20px 40px, 20px 40px, 20px 40px, 20px 40px';
  parent.style.backgroundSize='min(20%,2em)';check('inheritMath','font-size:40px;background-image:none,none;background-size:inherit','min(20%, 40px) auto, min(20%, 40px) auto');
  check('unset','background-size:unset','auto');check('initial','background-size:initial','auto');check('revert','background-size:revert','auto');
  check('registered','background-size:var(--registered)','30px auto','@property --registered{syntax:"<length>";inherits:false;initial-value:30px}');check('escaped','background-size:cover;background-size:c\\6f ntain','contain');check('uppercase','background-size:COVER','cover');
  sheet.textContent='';e.style.cssText='background-size:20px';e.style.backgroundSize='-2px';checks.invalidNegativeLength=s.backgroundSize==='20px auto';e.style.backgroundSize='-20%';checks.invalidNegativePercentage=s.backgroundSize==='20px auto';e.style.backgroundSize='cover contain';checks.invalidPair=s.backgroundSize==='20px auto';e.style.backgroundSize='cover,';checks.invalidList=s.backgroundSize==='20px auto';
  e.style.setProperty('BACKGROUND-SIZE','cover','important');checks.cssom=s.backgroundSize==='cover'&&e.style.getPropertyPriority('background-size')==='important';checks.removal=e.style.removeProperty('background-size')==='cover'&&s.backgroundSize==='auto';
  e.style.cssText='background-size:1em 2em';e.style.fontSize='30px';checks.liveFont=s.backgroundSize==='30px 60px';e.style.cssText='background-size:20px,cover';checks.liveTrim=s.backgroundSize==='20px auto';e.style.backgroundImage='none,none,none';checks.liveLayerCount=s.backgroundSize==='20px auto, cover, 20px auto';
  sheet.textContent='#target{background-size:contain!important}';checks.liveSheet=s.backgroundSize==='contain, contain, contain';sheet.textContent='#target{background-size:cover!important}';checks.liveSheetMutation=s.backgroundSize==='cover, cover, cover';sheet.textContent='';
  const external=document.createElement('div');external.id='external';parent.append(external);checks.external=getComputedStyle(external).backgroundSize===`${v+3}px auto`;
  e.style.background='none center / cover';checks.shorthand=s.backgroundSize==='cover';e.style.background='none';checks.shorthandReset=s.backgroundSize==='auto';
  const throws=(fn,name)=>{try{fn();return false;}catch(e){return e.name===name;}};checks.readOnly=throws(()=>{s.backgroundSize='cover'},'NoModificationAllowedError');checks.priority=s.getPropertyPriority('background-size')==='';checks.uppercaseRead=s.getPropertyValue('BACKGROUND-SIZE')==='auto';checks.enumeration=Array.from({length:s.length},(_,i)=>s.item(i)).filter(name=>name==='background-size').length===1;
  e.remove();checks.detached=s.backgroundSize==='';parent.append(e);checks.reattached=s.backgroundSize==='auto';sheet.remove();return checks;
}
